reviews.title: Powerhouse of a GFX card
reviews.comment: POWERHOUSE. I'm playing every game I own on 4k with max settings. The new DLSS just makes it get even crazier framerates, and I'm not even using framegen. 90+ FPS in Battlefield 6 with max settings at 4k.
reviews.author: Brad

reviews.title: Good Mix of Price vs Performance
reviews.comment: This was a GPU upgrade from RTX4080 to RTX5080 to utilize GPU tech advances. I use this for PCVR sims (DCS) and it requires the same tweaking as any other GPU used with VR.
reviews.author: Delmus

reviews.title: 5080 is supreme!
reviews.comment: ecently upgraded from an RTX 4060 Ti to this RTX 5080, and the difference is honestly staggering. While the 4060 Ti is a solid card for 1080p and light 1440p gaming, the 5080 is in an entirely different universe of performance!
